subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about recovering lapsed and cart-abandoning purchasers for {Brand}, in the tier Criteo and RTB House serve. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the confirmed purchase read server-side through the Conversions API, Enhanced Conversions, and S2S postbacks to your MMP, deduplicated on order and product ID, so the algorithm bids on real sales rather than re-clicks. At scale that has recovered around 3,000 purchases a day. Want me to send the lapsed-cohort recovery view?
angle: warm bump, restate server-side confirmed-purchase proof
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ecommerce retargeting: references prior outreach in S1; restates single proof (server-side confirmed-purchase optimization, dedup on order/product ID); one illustrative MobUpps figure (~3,000/day recovered); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native US English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; no em-dash.
